notes.title: Hot spring map update
notes.notes:
Villagers have a chance to appear on the map of the hot spring during the day or night.
You can check whether there are people in the hot spring on the small map. If you want to change people, you can sleep and refresh.

notes.title: Workshop update
notes.notes:
[b]Optimization:[/b]
The size of a single module is not limited to 100M.
Added TAB and sort filter Settings to Creative Workshop store

[b]BUG FIX:[/b]
Fixed too many error messages for subscription modules

notes.title: Update English translation
notes.notes:
Optimization:
1. Update English translation
2. Add Chinese CV (the original CV is also reserved and can be switched)
3. Record the resolution after players adjust the game window
4. Modify the rules for brushing trees on the doorstep and village map (reduce the number of trees)
Repair:
1. Fix the problem of plants blocking villains during the Mid Autumn Festival
2. Fix the problem that no wild ginseng can be found

notes.title: Recent update plan - 2022/10/8
notes.notes:
[h1] Near term plan [/h1]
Including but not limited to the following:
1. Press shift or click icon to switch between "walking" and "running"
2. Open the map to see the NPC location and whether there are currently available tasks
3. Shy things will move to more reasonable areas
4. You can watch Shugen Family's "Meat Pie Making" again
5. Difference between plots after strengthening watering
6. Shorten the ripening time of crops
7. Display the countdown days of ripeness when pointing at crops
8. Extend the passage of time
9. Enrich NPC dialogue
10. It is tentatively planned to add a shyness pose for each NPC (this will be completed at the end of the month)
[h1] Next phase plan [/h1]
1. The production of items will be opened by the carpenter (such as "automatic watering tools")
2. Allow changing clothes when you are shy
3. Contents of the Map of Hot Spring Development
4. As stated in the store profile, updating the text volume to a stable version will promote CV dubbing
